typography: title-face sign legends, ink body text on enamel plates, mono gate codes
composition: court-entrance checkline of condition plates feeding a presidential approval counter, measure dispatch desk splitting fines and detention amount lanes, unit responsibility fork escalating from the unit to responsible persons and criminal liability
